[Verse 1]
[A#m]I hope ya
[F#]flip some guy the bird,
[C#m]He cuts you
[G#]off and you're forced to swerve,
[A#m]In front of
[F#]the Beatles' tour bus,
[C#m]A Bookmobile
[G#]and a Mack truck,
[A#m]Hauling hazar-
[F#]dous biological waste,
[C#m]The light turns red
[G#]you have no brakes,
[A#m]And "Hard Copy"
[F#]gets it all on tape,
[C#m]So you can see
[G#]the look on your face,

[Bridge]
[A#m]Die Die
[F#]Die Die
[C#m]Die Die
[G#]Die!,
[A#m]Die Die
[F#]Die Die
[C#m]Die Die
[G#]Die!,

[Verse 2]
[A#m]I hope your
[F#]Pinto begins to spin,
[C#m]Takes out a di-
[G#]sabled Vietnam Veteran,
[A#m]Mows down a
[F#]Nobel Peace Prize Win-
[C#m]ner, And maybe some or-
[G#]phans having Christmas dinner,
[A#m]Perhaps even the Bri-
[F#]tish Royal Family,
[C#m]And the Rabbi that's
[G#]clutching the bottlefed puppy,
[A#m]And we can't forget
[F#]the newlyweds,
[C#m]And those Jerry's Kids are
[G#]as good as dead,

[Chorus]
[A#m]I hope this
[F#]helps to emphasize,
[C#m]
[G#]
[A#m]I hope this
[F#]helps to clarify,
[C#m]
[G#]I hope you

[Bridge]
[A#m]die,

[C#m]

[A#m]

[Verse 3]
[A#m]I hope your
[F#]cellmate thinks he's God,
[C#m]But C. N. N. refer to
[G#]him as "Bowling Ball Bag Bob",
[A#m]Serving time again
[F#]for abuse of a corpse,
[C#m]Only this time the
[G#]victim's a Clydesdale horse,
[A#m]While he masturbates
[F#]to photos of livestock,
[C#m]He does the "Silence of the
[G#]Lambs" dance to Christian Rock,
[A#m]Eats feces and
[F#]quotes from "Deliverance",
[C#m]And fights with his i-
[G#]maginary playmate Vince,

[Bridge]
[A#m]Die Die
[F#]Die Die
[C#m]Die Die
[G#]Die!,
[A#m]Die Die
[F#]Die Die
[C#m]Die Die
[G#]Die!,

[Verse 4]
[A#m]I hope he
[F#]grins like Jack Nicholson,
[C#m]And forces you to play a
[G#]game called Balls On Chin,
[A#m]And whatever happens
[F#]next is all a blur,
[C#m]But you remember
[G#]"fist" can be a verb,
[A#m]And when you fina-
[F#]lly regain consciousness,
[C#m]You're bound and gagged
[G#]in a wedding dress,
[A#m]And the prison guard
[F#]looks the other way,
[C#m]'Cause he's the guy ya flipped the
[G#]bird the other day,

[Chorus]
[A#m]I hope this
[F#]helps to emphasize,
[C#m]
[G#]
[A#m]I hope this
[F#]helps to clarify,
[C#m]
[G#]I hope you

[Outro]
[A#m]die,
